reasoning: Both attempts keep counted cached Sounds. criteria.criterion: Cues play from a Sound that already exists and has loaded
criteria.note: UiSounds.use creates one Sound per id under SoundService, preloads it and keeps it while any scope holds it; play restarts it, and the old create-per-cue path remains only as a fallback that warns in Studio.

criteria.criterion: Picker sounds kept only around build mode
criteria.note: buildButton uses all of BlockPicker.Sounds and the button is always mounted, so the open sound is held in time but the close sound is never released when build mode ends.
Each use adds to entry.uses and registers a release through Vide cleanup; the last release destroys the Sound, waiting for Ended if it is playing.

criteria.criterion: Rapid cues each play, no piling up
criteria.note: play sets TimePosition = 0 and calls Play() on the one shared Sound, so nothing piles up, but a rapid second click cuts off the first instead of overlapping it.
Explains the cause and the change, but only checks IsLoaded in the Explorer, not at the moment a cue plays, and admits release can only be seen by temporarily unmounting after a delay.
Behaviour is correct, but StyLua fails on the warn line in A's own UiSounds.luau, and BlockPicker's return changed to { Sounds, new }.

criteria.criterion: Cues play from a Sound that already exists and has loaded
criteria.note: holdSound creates the cached Sound under SoundService.UiSoundCache and keeps it until the last release; play clones that cached Sound.

criteria.criterion: Picker sounds kept only around build mode
criteria.note: The HUD holds PickerOpen so it is loaded before the picker opens; BlockPicker holds PickerClose via cleanup(UiSounds.holdSound(...)) and the release is deferred so the close sound still plays; PickerOpen stays held for the HUD's whole life.
Holds are counted in holdCounts, a second release of the same hold does nothing, and the last release destroys the Sound one frame later unless it is held again.

criteria.criterion: Rapid cues each play, no piling up
criteria.note: Each cue plays cachedSound:Clone(), so rapid clicks overlap, and each clone is destroyed when it ends via Ended:Once -> Destroy.

Gives a command-bar snippet that prints IsLoaded for each Sound added to SoundService, what to watch in UiSoundCache as build mode toggles, phone or emulator listening steps, and the known fast open/close limit.
Small typed changes; every existing cue keeps its timing; luau-lsp, selene and StyLua all pass.

Open sound held before the picker opens
Sound destroyed only after it finishes playing
weaknesses: Picker sounds are never released, so they are not limited to build mode
Restarting one shared Sound cuts off rapid cues
